messages:
Maya (AE): FinBank needs BYO HSM-only CMKs for the POC. Key asks: HSM attestation, monthly rotations, <50ms unwrap median, encrypted escrow with multi-custodian shards, and pricing impact. Can we draft short answers and a runbook to send?

Rohan (SE): We support BYO-CMK via cloud HSM endpoints or customer-hosted HSMs. Extra network hop adds ~10-40ms; with privatelink/VPC peering we can usually hit <50ms. We can provide a small wrap/unwrap test harness for their engineers and run an internal synthetic from our agents.

Kayla (Security): For questionnaire: request attestation artifact (HSM cert/nonce), list allowed principals, require JSON immutable audit logs (90/365 retention choices), rotation playbook (dual-key overlap), and explicit opt-in for Redwood fallback CMK. I'll draft short answers.

Diego (SRE): Ops notes: require >=24h overlap for rotation in prod; zero-overlap is a hard no. Retries/backoff for transient KMS errors; expose per-unwrap metric and alert if median >200ms or 5xx >1%. Will author 1-page runbook.

Legal (Tess): BYO-HSM changes liabilities and custody clauses. If they want Redwood-managed escrow we need SOW addendum and audit-rights language. Customer-operated escrow (they provide sealed shards) is simplest.

ContractBot: Created TASK-5512 assigned to Rohan/Kayla/Diego due in 3 business days.

Maya (AE): Plan: push customer-operated escrow as default, offer Redwood-managed escrow as premium. Rohan/Kayla/Diego drop artifacts here by EOD so I can reply to their security questionnaire and confirm pricing.

Rohan (SE): Will upload test harness + cost sketch (est. surcharge ~ $0.0025-0.003 per key-op at scale) by 4pm PT.

Kayla (Security): Questionnaire draft by 3pm PT.

Diego (SRE): Runbook and SLO bullets by 5pm PT.

Maya (AE): Thanks all, sending customer a tentative POC slot once we have drafts.
